sql: WITH artist_counts AS (SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist) SELECT DISTINCT c.artist AS illustrator, l.format FROM cards AS c JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid JOIN artist_counts AS ac ON ac.artist = c.artist WHERE ac.card_count = (SELECT MIN(card_count) FROM artist_counts) ORDER BY c.artist, l.format;
